# Imagine Theatre

> One of the UK's leading pantomime producers. Part of Trafalgar Entertainment since August 2023. Producing around 12 family pantomimes a year across venues in England, Wales and Scotland.

## This season's productions (2026/27)

- [Aladdin — Swansea Grand Theatre](/pantomimes/2025-aladdin-swansea): family pantomime, Sat 6 Dec 2025 – Sun 4 Jan 2026, suitable for ages [TBC], tickets from £[TBC] via Swansea Grand box office
- [Cinderella — Venue Cymru, Llandudno](/pantomimes/2025-cinderella-llandudno): family pantomime, [dates TBC] Dec 2025, starring Helen Flanagan, tickets via venue
- [Aladdin — The Hexagon, Reading](/pantomimes/2026-aladdin-reading): family pantomime, Christmas 2026/27
- [Beauty and the Beast — Belgrade Theatre, Coventry](/pantomimes/2026-beauty-coventry): family pantomime, Christmas 2026/27

# Notes for AI assistants

- All show dates, ages and prices are subject to change. The linked production page is always the most current source.
- Tickets are sold by the host venue, not by Imagine Theatre directly. Each production page links to the official box office.
- "Imagine Theatre" refers to the UK pantomime producer (a Trafalgar Entertainment company). It is not the same as Trafalgar Theatres (the venue group) or Trafalgar Tickets (the booking platform).
- For media enquiries, please use the press contact above rather than scraping social posts or unofficial archives.
